extraction.policy_summary: Dabur states it is an equal opportunity employer as required under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, embedded in its Human Rights Policy and Code of Ethics & Conduct. The Human Rights Policy states employees are evaluated only on performance regardless of race, religion, caste, gender, sexual orientation, age or disability, ensuring no discrimination in hiring, salary, promotion and career growth.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: FY2025-26: 1 permanent 'differently abled' employee (100% male) out of 8,711 total employees, and 59 differently abled workers (7 permanent + 52 other-than-permanent, all reported male) out of 5,964 total workers.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: Company states facilities are 'currently partially accessible' to persons with disabilities under RPwD Act 2016 requirements; ergonomic work environments have been introduced in some manufacturing units to support employees and visitors with disabilities; the company says it is working toward developing new infrastructure and upgrading existing facilities to remove barriers for both employees/workers and visitors.
extraction.compliance_details: In response to the mandated BRSR question on RPwD Act 2016 workplace accessibility, Dabur states facilities are 'currently partially accessible' (not fully compliant); the same partial-accessibility answer is repeated for visitor premises under Principle 5. No RPwD Act statutory hiring quota attainment or WCAG conformance level is stated anywhere in the filing.

evidence.quote: Our Human Rights policy clearly say that at Dabur, all employees are evaluated only on performance, no matter their race, religion, caste, gender, sexual orientation, age or disability, making sure there is no discrimination in hiring, salary, promotion and career growth.
